detail.longDescription: Why do we age — and can science slow it? Aging is not one biological clock. It is a network involving DNA damage, cellular senescence, mitochondrial dysfunction, inflammation, epigenetic change and declining repair. Longevity research is now testing which parts of that network can actually be changed. https://www. nexthorizon.space/2026/09/why- do-we-age-science-of-aging-and.html # Science # Biology # Health # Research # Aging # Longevity # Geroscience # Healthspan
